No ads No in-game purchases No internet required No account, no tracking One purchase unlocks everything, forever

Guide the snake to the apples to grow. Don\'t bite your own tail. There are no walls: leaving one edge brings you back on the opposite side. Golden bonuses appear now and then and vanish quickly: grab them for 5 points.
Swipe up, down, left or right to turn.
Slide the tiles: two equal tiles that touch merge into one with double the value. Reach 2048. The game ends when the board is full and nothing can merge.
Swipe in any direction to slide all tiles.

Bounce the ball off the paddle to break every brick: where it touches the paddle or a brick changes its angle. You have 3 lives: don\'t let the ball fall. Ten different levels: some bricks take two or three hits, grey steel bricks never break (clear all the others to move on). Once you have reached a level, you can pick it from the level screen when you start a game. Broken bricks sometimes drop capsules: catch the green ones (x3 balls, big ball, slow ball, big paddle, extra life) and dodge the red ones (fast ball, small paddle).
Drag your finger left or right to move the paddle. Tap to launch the ball.
Watch the colors light up, then repeat the same sequence. It gets one step longer every round. One mistake and it\'s over.
Tap the colored pads in the same order.
Find all the matching pairs of cards with as few attempts as possible. In two players, you play again after a match.
Tap a card to flip it, then tap a second one.
Put the tiles back in order, from 1 to 15, using the empty space. Fewer moves is better.
Tap a tile next to the empty space, or swipe to slide a tile into it.
Be the first to line up three of your marks, in a row, column or diagonal. Alone, you play against a computer that never makes a mistake.
Tap an empty square to place your mark.
Send the ball past your opponent\'s paddle. First to 7 points wins. Alone, you play against the computer; with two players, you share the screen.
Drag your paddle with your finger. Each player uses their own half of the screen.
Drop discs into the columns. The first to line up four discs, in a row, column or diagonal, wins. Alone, you play against the computer.
Tap a column to drop your disc.
Fly between the pipes without touching them. Each pipe passed scores one point.
Tap the screen to flap and gain height. The bird falls when you do nothing.
Uncover every square that hides no bomb. A number tells how many bombs touch that square. There are 10 bombs. Your first tap is always safe.
Tap a square to uncover it. Press and hold to put a flag. Tap a number with enough flags around it to uncover the rest.
Find the secret word by guessing letters. Seven wrong letters and you lose.
Tap a letter on the keyboard.
Place discs to trap your opponent\'s discs between yours: they flip to your color. Whoever has the most discs at the end wins. If you can\'t play, your turn is skipped.
Tap a square where you can flip at least one disc.
Fill the grid so that every row, every column and every 3x3 block contains the digits 1 to 9 once. Wrong digits show in red.
Choose a difficulty, tap an empty square, then tap a digit on the pad. Use the erase key to clear a square.
Reveal the hidden picture. The numbers beside each row and column tell the lengths of the runs of filled squares in it. Cross the squares you know are empty.
Tap or drag to fill squares. Press and hold to put a cross.
